desc.en: An enormous dragon that suddenly appeared in the Dusk Sea after the Sand Dragon was killed. It appears similar to the Sand Dragon, and sinks any ships that intrude upon its new territory.
desc.ja: サンドドラゴンのいなくなった黄昏の海に突如現れた超大型の竜。サンドドラゴンに似た姿や生態を持ち、新たな縄張りに侵入してきた船をことごとく沈めている

note: Between Ruins of Frozen Time and Altar of Spirits
